equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: DrawingStyle normalizes valid fill values to 'none' or a lowercase '#rrggbb' value. Both predicates are false for 'none'; '#' sorts before 'n', so both are true for every normalized painted fill.
DrawingStyle constrains fill_opacity to [0.0, 1.0]. Both predicates are false exactly at 0.0 and true for every other valid opacity.
The immediately preceding cardinality check requires exactly one M point. Index 0 and index -1 therefore select the same sole tuple.
The supported-command check limits values to M, L, H, V, or Z, and M has already continued. Among L, H, V, and Z, only Z is lexicographically greater than or equal to Z.
Every active subpath starts with exactly one M point and commands only extend it, so len(current) is always at least one. Over positive integers, greater than one and not equal to one are equivalent.
At this branch M and Z have continued and L has taken the prior branch, leaving only H or V. H <= H is true and V <= H is false, exactly matching equality with H.
